description: A tuple argument for a list of the dynamic pseudo-type becomes a list of its unified element type
notes: The spec's function call rules make a call erroneous when an argument doesn't match its parameter's type specification, which only an identical type or the dynamic pseudo-type does, and don't mention converting arguments; only the general section on conversions says that automatic conversion is attempted when values don't match what an operation expects. hashicorp/hcl converts each argument to its parameter's type with go-cty's convert.Convert before checking it (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), so the tuple becomes a list, and because the list's element type is the dynamic pseudo-type, go-cty unifies the element types string and number to string (conversionTupleToList in cty/convert/conversion_collection.go).
